title: pilosella malacotricha
intro: Pilosella malacotricha, commonly known as Sheep's Sorrel, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella malacotricha include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
